title: Continuous-state robust CVaR portfolio optimization via grid-restricted constraint generation: Code, Data, and Empirical Results
description:
This archive contains the complete reproducible experimental codebase, historical market dataset, empirical result tables, and high-resolution publication figures for the research paper: 'Continuous-state robust CVaR portfolio optimization via grid-restricted constraint generation' by Madani Bezoui and Thiziri Sifaoui.

### Contents:
- `code/`: Complete Julia and Python implementation of the continuous-state robust portfolio optimization model, grid-restricted constraint generation algorithm, HiGHS LP master solver, full-grid separation oracle, 31-year rolling backtest pipeline, and publication figure generator.
- `data/`: Aligned daily returns for Kenneth French 30 Industry Portfolios alongside CBOE VIX and market drawdown indicators spanning 1990--2026.
- `results/`: Complete experimental outputs, including 14-metric performance tables, crisis-period analysis, transaction cost sweeps, circular block-bootstrap distributions, sensitivity analyses, and high-resolution PDF publication plots.
- `paper/`: Compiled PDF of the manuscript, cover letter, and research highlights.
